edges.reason: Constructor sets the token contract reference
Constructor sets starter pack card level
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable
draftNewCard requires marketplace to be set
draftNewCard calls token approval and mint
draftNewCard creates a card entry indirectly
levelUp reads and mutates the challenger card struct
challenge reads challenger and defender card structs
challenge routes developer fee into totalDeveloperCut
challenge indirectly updates the ranking array
_simulateBattle mutates card exp, rank and hp
_createCard hash generation uses event range minimum
_createCard hash generation uses event range maximum
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner
onlyOwnerOf modifier checks token ownership against msg.sender
onlyOwnerOf modifier and self-challenge check use msg.sender
onlyOwnerOf modifier checks avatar update caller
msg.sender receives the drafted card and is compared to referrer
msg.sender receives the starter pack card
randomness depends on block.number and blockhash
block.number and now are recorded in battle history
_createCard calls generateHash for the new card
getRandom relies on blockhash derived entropy
external transfer can re-enter _transferFees state updates
newOwner parameter flows into owner assignment
referrer parameter controls the referrer payout
_defenderRank is validated against the defender card rank
_statUp gem allocation is validated and applied in challenge
_initLevel indexes exp arrays without bounds safety
_cardId selects the card whose hash is updated
avatarHash is written into the card hash
ranks array drives the distribution loop
tokensPerRank determines the value seeded per rank
totalInputGems accumulates user gem inputs before comparison
referrerCut derived from msg.value via mul then paid out
remainFee is transferred back to the challenger
tempAttackStrength damage math mutates tracked hp
withdrawalSum derives from totalDeveloperCut for payout
balance is compared against the withdrawal sum

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner parameter exists only to set the owner state via transferOwnership
_address parameter is only used to set the marketplace reference
_upgradeGems parameter is only consumed by setSettingValues
_newStarterPackPrice parameter is only consumed by setStarterPack
_newCardDrawPrice parameter is only consumed by setCardDrawPrice
_id parameter identifies the card in levelUp
_attackLevelUp parameter is a gem allocation in levelUp
_criticalRateLevelUp parameter is a gem allocation in levelUp
referrer parameter controls the payout logic in draftNewCardWithReferrer
_challengerCardId parameter selects the attacker in challenge
_defenderCardId parameter selects the defender in challenge
_defenderRank parameter is validated inside challenge
_statUp array parameter allocates flexi gems inside challenge
_to parameter is the mint recipient in _createCard
_initLevel parameter sets the starting level in _createCard
_cardId parameter selects the card in updateAvatar
avatarHash parameter is merged into the card hash in updateAvatar
_challengeFee parameter is the fee input to _calculateFee
_cardLevel parameter bounds the promo card in generateInitialCard
ranks array parameter drives the loop in distributeTokensToRank
tokensPerRank parameter sets the seeded amount in distributeTokensToRank
_challengerSpeed parameter feeds initiative in _isChallengerAttackFirst
_defenderSpeed parameter feeds initiative in _isChallengerAttackFirst
totalInputGems local only validates gems inside levelUp
referrerCut local is computed and paid only in draftNewCardWithReferrer
developerFee local is computed and forwarded only in challenge
requiredChallengeFee local gates the payment in challenge
totalGained local accumulates payouts in _transferFees
remainFee local is computed and transferred in _transferFees
tempAttackStrength local mutates hp inside _simulateBattle
battleSequence local is built inside _simulateBattle
withdrawalSum local determines the payout in withdrawBalance
balance local is compared in withdrawBalance
numOfSpecials local determines special gems in levelUp
